philippines-national-2014.notes: Both sources are second-hand news articles (press release / student newspaper) with partial rankings (places 1, 2, 4, 5); pack roles were only rankings, I added report and the partial flag applies. The article cites no year for the date 'September 6'; the publication date is 2014.

sources.evidence: The page is a GMA News Online article published October 8, 2014 naming the 2014 Philippine National Programming Competition and the places of four teams.
The page is a The GUIDON article published November 11, 2014 on the ACM-ICPC national contest held at the Ateneo de Naga University on September 6, giving the top five places except third.

philippines-national-2015.notes: Pack date 2015-09-05 matches the Visayas invitational in this post, not the national final (19 October 2015, as announced in July; schedule may have changed). Source is a pre-contest announcement.

sources.evidence: The blog post announces the 2015 ACM ICPC Philippines National Programming Contest (onsite final round) with its date, venue and mechanics.
